preconditions.description: Attacker must be the current owner of the contract

exploit_hint: As the current owner, call transferOwnership(address(0)) to set _newOwner to address(0). This creates a situation where ownership can be transferred to the zero address. Then call acceptOwnership() from address(0) (which is impossible), leaving the contract without a valid owner. The contract will be permanently locked from all owner-only functions including withdraw, setMinter, freeze/unfreeze, and blacklist management.
